answer: WITH b AS (SELECT df."RecordRegistry" AS flow_id, (rm.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'risk_score')::numeric / NULLIF((rm.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'control_effectiveness_pct')::numeric, 0) AS res, ((df.flow_overview->'performance'->>'success_pct')::numeric / ((df.flow_overview->'performance'->>'error_count')::numeric + 1)) * (1 - (df.flow_overview->'performance'->>'retry_count')::numeric / ((df.flow_overview->'performance'->>'error_count')::numeric + 1)) AS dfrs FROM "DataFlow" df JOIN "RiskManagement" rm ON rm.flow_link = df."RecordRegistry") SELECT flow_id, ROUND(res, 2) AS res, ROUND(dfrs, 2) AS dfrs FROM b WHERE res > 0.7 AND dfrs < 0.5
note: 'High RES and low DFRS' read as Critical Data Flow Risk: RES > 0.7 and DFRS < 0.5.

answer: WITH a AS (SELECT df."RecordRegistry" AS flow_id, ac."critFindNum"::numeric / (ac."FINDTALLY" + 1) AS afs, (COALESCE(ac."AccReqNum",0) + COALESCE(ac."DEL_REQ_NUM",0) + COALESCE(ac.rect_req_num,0) + COALESCE(ac."PORTREQNUM",0)) AS dsr, DATE '2025-04-01' - ac."REMED_DUE" AS days_overdue FROM "AuditAndCompliance" ac JOIN "DataProfile" dp ON dp."profileTrace" = ac.profjoin JOIN "DataFlow" df ON df."RecordRegistry" = dp."Flow_Sign" WHERE df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country' <> df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country') SELECT flow_id, ROUND(afs * dsr * afs, 2) AS audit_compliance_pressure, days_overdue FROM a WHERE afs * dsr * afs > 5 AND days_overdue > 0 AND days_overdue <= 5 ORDER BY days_overdue DESC, afs * dsr * afs DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT "profileTrace" AS profile_id, (CASE WHEN "Int_check" = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN "CSUMVERIFY" = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ifc, CONCAT_WS(', ', CASE WHEN "Int_check" = 'Failed' THEN 'Integrity Check' END, CASE WHEN "CSUMVERIFY" = 'Failed' THEN 'Checksum Verification' END) AS failure_types FROM "DataProfile" WHERE "Int_check" = 'Failed' OR "CSUMVERIFY" = 'Failed' ORDER BY ifc DESC, profile_id LIMIT 10

WITH b AS (SELECT df."RecordRegistry" AS flow_id, (rm.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'risk_score')::numeric / NULLIF((rm.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'control_effectiveness_pct')::numeric, 0) AS res, dp.vol_gb::numeric * CASE dp."dataSense" WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS dsi FROM "DataFlow" df LEFT JOIN "RiskManagement" rm ON rm.flow_link = df."RecordRegistry" LEFT JOIN "DataProfile" dp ON dp."Flow_Sign" = df."RecordRegistry") SELECT flow_id, ROUND(res, 2) AS risk_exposure_score, ROUND(dsi, 2) AS data_sensitivity_index FROM b WHERE res > 0.7 AND dsi > 100 ORDER BY dsi DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT "AUDIT_TRACE" AS audit_id, ROUND(((COALESCE("AccReqNum",0) + COALESCE("DEL_REQ_NUM",0) + COALESCE(rect_req_num,0) + COALESCE("PORTREQNUM",0)) * resp_time_day)::numeric, 2) AS dsrp, "AccReqNum" AS access_requests, "DEL_REQ_NUM" AS deletion_requests, rect_req_num AS rectification_requests, "PORTREQNUM" AS portability_requests FROM "AuditAndCompliance" WHERE (COALESCE("AccReqNum",0) + COALESCE("DEL_REQ_NUM",0) + COALESCE(rect_req_num,0) + COALESCE("PORTREQNUM",0)) * resp_time_day > 50 ORDER BY dsrp DESC LIMIT 100
note: Request breakdown returned as four count columns (access, deletion, rectification, portability) rather than one string.

answer: WITH a AS (SELECT TO_CHAR("REMED_DUE", 'YYYY-MM') AS month, "critFindNum"::numeric / ("FINDTALLY" + 1) AS afs FROM "AuditAndCompliance" WHERE "critFindNum"::numeric / ("FINDTALLY" + 1) > 0.5), g AS (SELECT month, AVG(afs) AS avg_afs, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(afs) DESC) AS severity_rank FROM a GROUP BY month) SELECT month, ROUND(avg_afs, 2) AS avg_afs, severity_rank FROM g WHERE severity_rank <= 3 ORDER BY month
note: Month taken from REMED_DUE, the only date on the audit table.

answer: WITH v AS (SELECT CASE "vendSecRate" WHEN 'A' THEN 4 WHEN 'B' THEN 3 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 WHEN 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END * CASE WHEN "contrState" = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0.5 END AS vri FROM "VendorManagement"), t AS (SELECT CASE WHEN vri < 2 THEN 'High' WHEN vri < 3 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS tier FROM v) SELECT tier, COUNT(*) AS vendor_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS percentage FROM t GROUP BY tier ORDER BY vendor_count DESC

WITH b AS (SELECT "RecordRegistry" AS flow_id, (flow_overview->'performance'->>'bandwidth_util_pct')::numeric * ((flow_overview->'performance'->>'data_size_mb')::numeric / NULLIF((flow_overview->'performance'->>'duration_min')::numeric, 0)) AS bsi, (flow_overview->'performance'->>'success_pct')::numeric / ((flow_overview->'performance'->>'error_count')::numeric + 1) AS dte FROM "DataFlow") SELECT flow_id, ROUND(bsi, 2) AS bsi, ROUND(dte, 2) AS dte FROM b WHERE bsi > 50 AND dte < 1.0 ORDER BY bsi DESC LIMIT 10

WITH b AS (SELECT dp."profileTrace" AS profile_id, dp.vol_gb::numeric * CASE dp."dataSense" WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS dsi, CASE WHEN sp.enc_state = 'Full' AND sp.acl_state = 'Strong' THEN 3 WHEN sp.enc_state = 'Full' OR sp.acl_state = 'Strong' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS srs FROM "DataProfile" dp JOIN "SecurityProfile" sp ON sp.profile_key = dp."profileTrace") SELECT profile_id, ROUND(dsi, 2) AS data_sensitivity_index, srs AS security_robustness_score FROM b WHERE dsi > 100 AND srs < 2 ORDER BY dsi DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT c."complianceTrace" AS record_id, c."gdprComp" AS gdpr_status, c.loc_law_comp AS local_law_status, CONCAT(df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country', ' -> ', df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country') AS transfer_path FROM "Compliance" c JOIN "RiskManagement" rm ON rm."RISKTRACE" = c.risk_tie JOIN "DataFlow" df ON df."RecordRegistry" = rm.flow_link WHERE (df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country' IS DISTINCT FROM df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country') AND (c."gdprComp" = 'Non-compliant' OR c.loc_law_comp = 'Non-compliant') ORDER BY c."complianceTrace" LIMIT 10
